_source.title: 关闭文档
_source.remarks.text.0: 如若文档尚未保存，执行此操作将会直接丢失所有未保存的数据，请在修改操作完成后首先执行 {@link SCH_Document.save}、{@link PCB_Document.save}、{@link PNL_Document.save} 保存数据
_source.params.tabId: 标签页 ID，此处支持 {@link IDMT_SchematicPageItem.uuid}、{@link IDMT_PcbItem.uuid}、{@link IDMT_PanelItem.uuid} 作为输入

title: Close document
remarks.text.0: If the document has not been saved, executing this operation will directly lose all unsaved data. After completing modification operations, first execute {@link SCH_Document.save}, {@link PCB_Document.save}, and {@link PNL_Document.save} to save the data
params.tabId: Tab ID. Here {@link IDMT_SchematicPageItem.uuid}, {@link IDMT_PcbItem.uuid}, and {@link IDMT_PanelItem.uuid} are supported as input
